package_name: EQP Modern geological overlay starter pack
purpose: Map context and non-causal descriptive overlays only; NOT hypocenter solver inputs or definitive geological source attribution.
data_source: User-provided local GIS shapefiles; official authority, publication rights and operational use require verification.

trench_systems.status: REVIEW ONLY pending scientific and GIS review

known_issues: One trench record without coordinates is omitted (source row 12).
Active fault source has missing IDs for some features; output feature IDs are dataset-row-local, not permanent IDs.
Some active-fault line geometries repeat; no de-duplication performed.
The active fault file metadata has editing log through 2026-02-19 despite older dataset filename; validate the authorized data release.
Trench data are older and require confirmation of datum transformation and mapped geometry.
Do not equate epicentral proximity with causation or compute distance from shapefile st_length_ field.
